payload.bug_description: Stack-use-after-scope in xmlEscapeText (xmlIO.c): xmlEscapeText uses data from a stack-allocated temporary buffer after that buffer's lifetime ends, causing a read of stale stack memory (observed via a memcpy). This is reachable via node string handling / element validation (xmlNodeListGetStringInternal -> xmlValidateElement) and can lead to crashes or other memory-corruption impacts when parsing crafted XML.

#!/bin/bash
